Sometime between [[3681 BBY|3681]] and [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="date" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]],.<ref name="The Setting" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] fought a '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="The Setting" />

==Behind the scenes==
A battle on Dathomir during the Great Galactic War was first mentioned in the article "The Setting", on ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} website in [[October]] [[2008]]. However, any mention of this battle, as well as the [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|battle of Ilum]], was removed following an update of the website in [[June]] [[2011]].<ref name="The Setting" />
